title: Philippa Nuttall
gist: Prospect Magazine author index page for Philippa Nuttall, a freelance journalist specialising in the climate and biodiversity crises, listing nine articles. There is no article body — only a bio line and headline listing, so extractable signal is limited to the shape of her climate beat.

insights.claim: Philippa Nuttall writes for Prospect as a freelance journalist specialising in the climate and biodiversity crises, giving the magazine a dedicated climate-policy contributor rather than generalist coverage.
insights.so_what: Useful only for sourcing: identifies the byline to follow for Prospect's climate and biodiversity policy coverage.
insights.quote: Philippa Nuttall is a freelance journalist specialising in the climate and biodiversity crises
insights.locator: Philippa Nuttall is a freelance journalist
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine

insights.claim: Her listed Prospect output clusters on climate-adjacent policy failure — climate diplomacy not saving the planet, the UAE hosting COP28, the climate after Europe's election, and wildfires hitting the food supply.
insights.so_what: Indicates where the UK/EU ideas press is aiming its climate scepticism — at process and diplomacy rather than at the science.
insights.locator: Climate / The wildfires and the food supply
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine

insights.claim: One listed headline argues explicitly that societies need to prepare for mass climate migration, placing adaptation and population movement rather than mitigation at the centre of her framing.
insights.so_what: Mass climate migration as a planning assumption is the theme to track for long-horizon fiscal, insurance and border-policy exposure.
insights.quote: We need to prepare for mass climate migration
insights.locator: Climate / We need to prepare for mass climate migration
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine

insights.claim: The index shows only nine Prospect articles in total, so this contributor's footprint at the title is small and episodic rather than a standing column.
insights.so_what: Low output volume means this byline is not a reliable regular signal source compared with the magazine's columnists.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
